summary: Donna ISD urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program and maintain access to qualified third‑party consultants. Donna ISD urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program, maintain the ability to use qualified third‑party consultants, and keep the current scope of eligible services, especially internal connections and Wi‑Fi. Donna ISD urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate eligibility for network infrastructure that supports instructional, administrative, operational, and safety functions, arguing that narrowing the definition of "educational purpose" would impose undue financial burdens on the district. Donna ISD urges the FCC to preserve local control over screen‑time policies, allow network‑level filtering for all devices, and continue supporting Head Start and Pre‑K programs, while opposing rigid federal screen‑time limits and requiring administrative control of personally owned devices. Donna ISD supports continued use of qualified third‑party E‑Rate consultants while urging the FCC to streamline consultant definitions, disclosure, and record‑keeping requirements and to protect districts from penalties when consultants err.
